title: Migrate unsupported enum flag operations
goal: Replace rejected non-integer enum bit operations with integer-backed permissions.

selectionNotes: Use integer-backed bits; persisted character codes need an explicit mapping.

prerequisites: Use an F# net11.0 executable or library, .NET 11 SDK, FSharp.Core 11 and LangVersion=11.0.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Use the .NET 11 SDK and its F# compiler for the declared target.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: This verified edition targets net11.0; the .NET 10 sample is a comparison, not an older-target catalogue route.

language.name: F#
language.reason: Compiled in stable F# 11 language mode.

constraints: FlagsAttribute alone does not repair a non-integer enum; the integer representation and bit values matter.

Changing an existing public enum underlying type or persisted representation can break consumers. Fictional DockAccess is a replacement permission model; no automatic wire/data migration or already-working char semantics is claimed.

packages.name: FSharp.Core
packages.reason: FSharp.Core 11 is the library dependency for this edition; the exact compiled RC2 version is recorded separately in evidence.

evidence.scope: Actual FSharpFlags compilation and managed execution including flags assertions; separate compiler/external-consumer probes in eng/Test-FSharpBoundaries.ps1. No mocks, cross-compilation, native/AOT deployment or GA execution claimed.
